transcript.content: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in, I really appreciate it. Um, I hope I'm explaining this right, but... I guess I'm here because things have been a little difficult at my job lately. I'm a retail buyer, and... well, I've just been getting this really strong feeling that some of the people at work, and even some of our vendors, are tracking what I buy. 

Like, it feels like they're purposely messing with the launch numbers to make me look stupid. I know how that sounds, and I really don't want to come across as paranoid or anything. My supervisor even sat me down and pulled up the reports to show me that the numbers don't prove any of that is happening, but... I just can't seem to shake the feeling. 

I'm sorry, does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and not wasting your time.

Over the past few weeks, how would you describe your overall mood? Have you been feeling depressed, sad, or down most of the time, or has your mood been relatively normal aside from the concerns at work?

Um, no, I wouldn't say I've been depressed. I mean... I think my mood has been pretty normal, honestly? Like you said, just aside from the work stuff. 

I try to stay really positive, so I definitely haven't been sad or down most of the time. I'm actually usually a pretty upbeat guy, I think. I hope that's a helpful answer? I just don't want you to think I'm, like, sitting around crying or anything, because I'm really not. Is it okay that I feel mostly fine otherwise? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture.
When did you first start having these feelings that people at work were tracking you or messing with the numbers? Was it sudden, or did it develop gradually over time?

Um, I guess it's been going on for a while now... roughly ten months? It wasn't like a sudden thing, I promise, it just sort of developed gradually. 

But, um... there's actually something else, too. I really didn't want to say anything because I know exactly how bad it sounds, and I really, really don't want you to think I'm crazy... but along with those suspicious feelings at work, I've also been hearing... well, a voice? 

It's been happening for about ten months now, too. I try really hard to just ignore it and still do a good job at work, I swear. I hope it's okay that I'm telling you this? I know it's a lot, I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right answers and being a good patient.
When you hear this voice, what does it say to you? Does it give you commands or instructions, or does it more comment on what you're doing?

Um... well, it mostly just comments on things, I guess? I really hope this doesn't make me sound too crazy. But, like, sometimes when I'm in the stockroom, or if I'm driving back from a vendor meeting, I'll hear this man's voice. It sounds like it's coming from right behind me. 

He'll say things like, 'Move faster, Scott,' or he'll just kind of laugh at the merchandise picks I made. But when I turn around to look, there's nobody there at all. 

It's definitely not telling me to do anything bad or dangerous, I promise! I would never listen if it did. It's just... there, making comments. Does that answer what you were asking? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right details and being helpful.
Over these past ten months, have you experienced any periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed much less sleep than normal, or felt like you could accomplish a lot more than usual?

Um, well... I guess I have had some times like that? But I always just thought of it as a good thing, honestly. Like I'm just being really dedicated to my job, you know? 

There have definitely been plenty of weeks where I sleep maybe... I don't know, three or four hours a night? But I don't feel tired at all when it happens! I wake up feeling completely wired and ready to go. I just start thinking that lying in bed is basically just wasting time that I could use to make moves and get ahead with my vendors. 

I hope that doesn't sound like a bad thing? I really just try to be as productive as possible. Is it okay that I don't need as much sleep during those weeks? I just want to make sure I'm answering your question the right way and giving you what you need.

When you have those weeks where you sleep only 3-4 hours and feel wired and productive, do those weeks come in distinct clusters or episodes that last for a few weeks at a time, or does the decreased need for sleep happen on and off throughout most of the past 10 months?

Um, I guess... looking back on it, those weeks kind of take up most of the time? I mean, since this all started about ten months ago, I've mostly been in those... I guess you could call them wired stretches. 

It's not like it's every single day, I promise. There are shorter, calmer periods in between where I sleep a bit more. But mostly, yeah, it's been those longer stretches where I'm just really focused, maybe a little irritable if people slow me down, but honestly just feeling super confident and working really hard. 

I hope it's okay that I'm working so much? I just really want to do a good job. Does that make sense, the way I'm explaining the timeline? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.

When you first started noticing these feelings ten months ago, did the suspicious feelings about people tracking you and the voice come first, or did you start with the high energy and decreased need for sleep, and then the paranoid feelings and voice developed after that?

Um... well, it's kind of hard to separate them out, honestly? I really hope I'm explaining this right. But... they kind of all happened at the same time. 

Like, during those weeks when I was barely sleeping and just, you know, talking nonstop about all the new sneaker trends and feeling completely untouchable at work... that's exactly when I started feeling like the vendors were manipulating the numbers. And that's also when I would hear that voice telling me to move faster. 

It was all just sort of... mixed together, I guess? I wasn't trying to be paranoid or anything, I just... I had so much energy and my mind was moving so fast, and then the voice was there, and the suspicions. Is that... is that normal for someone working as hard as I was? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the timeline you need.
